Beyond my published research, this is where I keep hands-on data-science work —
end-to-end analyses that show *how* the methods behind my papers actually work.
Each project walks through the full pipeline: data cleaning and feature
engineering, modelling, evaluation, and clearly communicated results, with
reproducible R code throughout. The focus is health and epidemiology, but the
techniques — survival analysis, spatial modelling, regression, and classification —
transfer to almost any domain.
